description: Neurovirulence proteins have higher CNS-targeting composite scores
interpretation: Control proteins also extensively interact with CNS pathways; neurovirulence may be pathway-specific rather than broader CNS targeting. Test severely underpowered (n=3 vs n=8); non-significant result is inconclusive.

description: Target proteins have higher switch density than controls
interpretation: Switch density is similar; targets may use qualitatively different switches (immune evasion, autophagy) rather than more switches overall. Test severely underpowered; non-significant result is inconclusive.

description: Target switches preferentially involve CNS-enriched pathways
interpretation: CNS pathway engagement is comparable; neurovirulence specificity may arise from specific molecular targets (Beclin-1, PP1, TRAF6) rather than pathway breadth. Non-significant result is inconclusive given limited statistical power.
